test_title: PYST 34: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Out of the frying pan and into the fire

options.text: Things going from bad to worse
Things getting intense by the hour
Being with someone through good times as well as bad times

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Out of the frying pan and into the fire"** means moving from a bad situation to an even worse one. (बुरे स्थिति से और भी बुरी स्थिति में जाना) • **Example: **By quitting his job without having another one lined up, he jumped **out of the frying pan and into the fire**. • **Things going from bad to worse** refers to a situation that deteriorates further from an already bad state. (बुरी स्थिति से और भी बुरी स्थिति की ओर जाना) • **Example: **When the car broke down in the middle of nowhere, we realized** things were going from bad to worse.** Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Things going from bad to worse.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Things getting intense by the hour** (घंटे दर घंटे स्थिति गंभीर होना): This means that a situation is becoming more serious or intense as time passes. • **Example:** The storm was getting intense by the hour, making it difficult for rescue operations to continue. • **Being with someone through good times as well as bad times** (अच्छे और बुरे समय में किसी के साथ होना): This refers to staying loyal to someone regardless of the situation. • **Example:** She promised to be with him through good times as well as bad times. • **Being a horrible cook** (बहुत खराब खाना बनाना): This means someone is very bad at cooking. • **Example:** Despite his best efforts, he remains a horrible cook. 38:Tc0d, The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
